Slay a storm rider boss for a sample of its tissue.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = mesmer
}}

===Objectives===
* Slay [[Grenn Mindvenom]].
* Return to [[Erudine]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
*{{skill icon|Diversion}}

==Walkthrough==
Exit Serenity Temple and follow the quest marker to reach the giant crystal. The boss will spawn in the general area. Once you kill the boss, pick up the [[Storm Rider Tissue Sample]] and bring it back to Erudine for your reward.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
====Bosses====
[[Rider]]s
*{{me}} 9 (27) [[Grenn Mindvenom]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Erudine
:''"Have you also been studying the local flora and fauna?  I find the storm riders to be quite fascinating.  It seems they exhibit powers and abilities not dissimilar to those a Mesmer might use.  I have studied a few of the smaller species, and I believe their tissue might be put to some beneficial purpose.  I would like to take a sample of a particularly large subject called '''Grenn Mindvenom''', which I have seen near the large crystal in '''Pockmark Flats'''.

:''Will you collect the tissue sample for me?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Sounds interesting.  I'll to it.
| decline = That sounds disgusting!
| ask = No tissue sample yet? [[Grenn Mindvenom]] can be found near that massive crystal in Pockmark Flats.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Erudine
:''"Excellent!  Now that I have this tissue, I can begin my experiments immediately.  If things work as I have theorized, then I believe I can concoct an elixer that will help repair those whose minds have been damaged by severe mental trauma."''

==Notes==
